## Change

What changes for users? Link the related issue with `Closes #…` when applicable.

## Verification

Commands run and results; distinguish automated tests from actual UI/browser
checks. For Glint changes, include patch/revision and binary verification scope.
Mark anything not tested explicitly. Add screenshots for UI changes.

## Compatibility

Profile/settings/API impact, migration requirements and rollback if relevant.

## Checklist

- [ ] Focused change following existing project patterns.
- [ ] Regression coverage and relevant documentation updated.
- [ ] No secrets, personal profiles, private backend source or build artifacts.
- [ ] UTF-8 without BOM; no unrelated formatting/refactoring.
- [ ] Unverified engine behavior is not presented as a released capability.
